# Auto-generated from base AGOT history/provinces (see common/history/provinces override files
# in this submod, which cap every castle/city/temple tier at _01 - this is the companion that
# restores the original canon tier via pure add_building when no_holding_levels_enabled is OFF.
#
# Deliberately pure addition, never remove_building: add_building upgrading a building that
# already exists at a lower tier of the same family is the same atomic operation every normal
# construction/upgrade in the game uses, and is what agot_add_building_if_possible already relies
# on safely for every secondary building on the map. Explicitly calling remove_building on the
# primary castle/city/temple slot before re-adding - tried multiple ways, at multiple points in
# the game-start sequence - is what corrupted holdings (see the (now removed) comment history on
# agot_reset_holding_levels_on_start_effect). Capping the default in history and only ever adding
# upward from there avoids that operation entirely.
#
# Regenerate this file (and the history overrides) if base AGOT changes province building history.
agot_restore_holding_levels_on_start_effect = {
	if = {
